verdict.rationale: No documented audience export (CSV or otherwise) appears in the evidence. The only path is indirect: the MCP server can 'read and write contacts' and the CLI can 'manage contacts' with JSON output, so contacts could likely be pulled out self-serve through scripting. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export feature in an open format, export of custom fields and tags, engagement history export, suppression list export, a confirmed list/fetch-all-contacts endpoint, and any independent confirmation that full-audience export works.
